# FabFashion

> FabFashion is a B2B premium fabric manufacturer and exporter based in Mumbai, India, with a 50+ year legacy, producing cotton, blended, linen, and custom-woven fabrics for global fashion brands and garment exporters.

Operating a 60,000+ sq ft manufacturing facility equipped with 42+ Toyota JAT810 looms operating at 1100 RPM and digitally controlled humidification systems, FabFashion delivers over 15 Lac+ metres per month in production capacity. The company is family-owned and led by Proprietors Mr. Prahaldraj Bhutra, Mr. Damodar Bhutra, and Mr. Pratham Bhutra.

## Company

- [Our Story](https://www.fabfashionfabrics.com/about.html): Five-decade textile manufacturing journey, directors, mission, and company vision.
- [Why Choose FabFashion](https://www.fabfashionfabrics.com/whyus.html): Timely delivery, customized fabric solutions, commitment, and proven track record.
- [Manufacturing Infrastructure](https://www.fabfashionfabrics.com/infrastructure.html): 60,000+ sq ft facility, 42+ Toyota JAT810 looms, humidification, and R&D testing.
- [Contact Us](https://www.fabfashionfabrics.com/contact.html): Inquiry form for fabric samples, bulk quotations, and business partnerships.

## Products

- [Our Fabric Collections](https://www.fabfashionfabrics.com/collections.html): Full B2B fabric catalog with technical specifications and sample request options.
  - Oxford Weave: 100% Cotton, 110–130 GSM. Classic basket-weave construction for shirting.
  - Twill Fabric: 100% Cotton, 120–145 GSM. Diagonal ribbed pattern with a smooth finish.
  - Poplin & Stripes: 100% Cotton, 90–115 GSM. Ultra-fine tightly woven poplin weave.
  - Herringbone Pattern: Cotton / Poly Blend, 130–160 GSM. V-shaped weave with visual texture.
  - Custom Weaves: As Specified, Custom GSM. Bespoke weave patterns engineered to buyer specifications.
  - Linen Blend: Linen / Cotton Blend, 140–180 GSM. Natural breathability with cotton comfort.
